question: Does the codebase coupled q-omega ODE conserve L_J2000 over a full LC, and is the s065 'physical at -omega' framing valid over the LC duration?
hypothesis: The s065 omega-sign residual makes the m048 LCs real physical light curves of satellites tumbling at -omega0_rad.
narrative_md: The codebase coupled q-omega ODE does NOT conserve L_J2000: it drifts 36-137% of |L_body| over a 60-min LC across seeds 89/28/14 (textbook control on a toy holds to 1e-12; codebase toy drifts 191%). |L_body| is conserved to 1e-14 -- the Euler equation is correct, only the q-evolution is wrong. This SUPERSEDES s065: the omega-sign residual holds only at t=0 and over ~1 s windows, not over LC duration -- no global sign substitution fixes it (Euler RHS is even in omega). The m048 cached LCs are deterministic outputs of a self-consistent but NON-physical forward model; the inversion benchmark stays well-posed and methodology carries over, but fix-and-regen is strongly indicated. Propagates cohort truth states to measure drift (render-at-truth).
